# Sanofysi

> Sanofysi makes Prebiotic Syrup, a lightly sweet liquid fibre supplement made with 95% FOS (fructooligosaccharides). It is stirred into tea, coffee, porridge, yoghurt or smoothies to add prebiotic fibre to an everyday diet. Sanofysi sells to English, French and Swahili speaking markets.

## Product facts: Sanofysi Prebiotic Syrup

- Type: food supplement, liquid prebiotic fibre syrup
- Main ingredient: fructooligosaccharides (FOS) syrup, 95% FOS, 100% plant-based
- Bottle: 290 mL (9.8 fl oz), about 19 servings
- Serving size: 1 tablespoon (15 mL)
- Per serving: 35 calories; total carbohydrate 16 g; dietary fibre 14.3 g (52% of the daily value); total sugars 1.6 g
- Taste: mildly sweet, less sweet than sugar
- How to use: stir one 15 mL spoon into tea, coffee, yoghurt, porridge or a smoothie once a day. People new to fibre should start with a teaspoon and build up over one to two weeks.
- Price: USD 38 per bottle
- Not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease.
